record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare AQUA_TAIL: Oshawott (1 star), Dewott (2 stars), Samurott (3 stars). The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count (table index), range and maxPP. Units that merely evolve into or from these (e.g. Hisuian Samurott) are not covered unless listed.
record.summary: Deals SPECIAL damage (raw 30/60/100/200 by the caster's stars) to the cast target and gives the caster a shield of the same raw size (30/60/100/200). Both amounts come from separate tables that currently hold identical numbers.

targeting.who: damage: the cast target (the unit the caster is attacking when the cast fires); shield: the caster itself
targeting.note: The caster must reach its target (requiresTarget true). There is no area, line or secondary target. Which unit is chosen as the cast target is decided by the generic targeting code, which was not read.

effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1]. handleSpecialDamage: x (1 + AP/100) because apBoost defaults to true; x critPower (reduced by Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite on the target) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault is false, so needs ABILITY_CRIT); also x2 once if the caster holds the DOUBLE_DAMAGE effect (removed after use) and x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT on either side.
effects.resolution: applied (the figure handed to PokemonState.handleDamage) = requested after those multipliers. handleDamage then applies attacker/field/weather multipliers, divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef) (half speDef if armorReduction), rounds up with a minimum of 1, and the target's shield absorbs first. takenDamage reported = shield damage + HP damage (HP part capped at current hp); it is 0 if the target has protect / skydiving / magicBounce (blocked entirely, magic bounce may reflect).

effects.scaling: PokemonEntity.addShield: Big Eater Belt on the positive value (x1.25 rounded down); PokemonState.addShield with apBoost 1: x (1 + AP/100); x critPower only if the cast crit; x0.5 if the caster is enraged; Math.round
effects.resolution: applied = the rounded result added to the caster's shield, only if the caster's hp > 0; a negative total is not possible from these inputs. Damage later taken by the caster consumes this shield first in handleDamage.

starBehavior.note: Both tables are indexed by the casting entity's stars (2 for Dewott, 1 for Oshawott, 3 for Samurott as listed in the catalog); the 4-star column (200, also the ?? fallback) is not reachable by the bare factory star counts. Whether other mechanics raise an entity's star count was not examined.

record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP (floor 0), adds its shield on top of any existing shield (shields stack by addition), and deals its damage again.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: damage 30/60/100 and shield 30/60/100 for 1/2/3 stars. Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit / double-damage / steam multipliers, then reduced by the target's SPE_DEF with a minimum of 1; takenDamage includes shield damage. Applied shield = requested after Big Eater Belt, AP, crit, enraged halving and rounding. Final values additionally depend on untraced item and field effects.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Which unit is the cast target and when the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence, targeting) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution - only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate was located

Damage resolution after handleDamage's earlier branches (e.g. Shiny Charm, Fossil shield, resurrection, passives, weather and field multipliers) was only partly read: protect, SPE_DEF division, minimum 1 and shield absorption were read; later death handling was not
Whether the 500 ms magicBounce reflection or Power Lens retaliation matters: they were read in handleSpecialDamage but not simulated
unresolved: Order of the two effects within a cast is damage first, then shield: if the damage kills the target or triggers an on-death effect, effects keyed to that were not traced
Whether the caster's shield is applied when the damage cast was blocked: it is (addShield is not conditioned on the damage result)
Whether the three units ever reach a different star count than the bare factory value
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks only
